mathematical_findings.reason: Expanding all parabolic cosets gives a pairwise-intersecting collection of maximal-parabolic cosets; same-type intersections identify equal cosets. FT then supplies a common representative.

Reduced syllables characterize P*Q membership. Cosets give subtrees whose edge labels are exact group cosets. Finite subtree Helly reduces to pairwise-intersecting local P or Q cosets, including trivial factors.
The factor retractions send lifted source flags back to common representatives. No trivial-Borel assumption is required.
Mixed residues contain both full factors; pure-side residues reduce by retraction to source residue generation. Rank-one residues are not erroneously required connected.
The all-n reduced words (uv)^n yield infinitely many panel cosets whenever U0<U and the opposite Borel is nontrivial. Thinness therefore needs trivial Borels when both sides have a type.

The source permits nonfaithful acting homomorphisms and rank-one inputs. Each (C2^2,C2) input is thin/FT/RC, whereas the free-product panels are infinite. The retained faithful/trivial-Borel version is unaffected.

Each B_q contains C; a fixed reduced transversal simultaneously tests membership. Intersecting over q forces every B syllable into C and gives G_Q=A. The single special-subgroup embedding yields G_i intersect A=A_i, with no false pairwise-special intersection formula. Empty private type sets are treated.
An explicitly indexed action is assumed. Orbit intersections are invariant, so the two kinds of cosets are exactly Cartesian fibers; this proves incidence join, all parabolics, Borel, and FT.
The relative generation induction retains H_A also at the empty set. Every minimal parabolic lies in a remaining coarse residue parabolic; this proves RC before the ordinary join argument.
Four cosets H,xH,yH,xyH are distinct using only R_i intersect R_k=H; the proof does not assume H normal. Nontrivial type orbits obstruct thinness, trivial ones do not.
R_k>H contradicts A_J<=A_K when k belongs to K but not J. Thus the actual subgroup poset is reverse Boolean, including injectivity.

The unlabelled lattice isomorphism permutes coatoms of the firm Boolean intervals, giving a unique partial type bijection; intersections then give every indexed formula. Empty intersections are explicitly within the codomain A_K.

On each equivalence class the partial bijection maps s\J onto s\K, giving phi(A_s intersect A_J)=A_s intersect A_K. This is exactly the compatibility required by the previously accepted local HNN theorem.

The eight coordinate subspaces are permuted, but the fourth named subgroup is not index-permuted. Stable-letter orbit closure is the whole F2^3; the displayed source intersection formula fails. This particular output nevertheless remains FT, as the note explicitly states.
